title: Felix and the Detention
author: Ansel Quintana
blurb: Petra Marchetti, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
